metaDescription: The portfolio of Jonas Garet, engineering student interested in digital hardware and CPU design.
heroStatus: First-year engineering student in digital sciences at ENSEEIHT, Toulouse.
presentationBody: I am a first-year student in the digital sciences department at ENSEEIHT in Toulouse. I am drawn to the way computing systems work beneath the surface, from logic circuits to processors.
ambitionBody: I want to deepen my knowledge of microelectronics, with a particular interest in CPU and logic-circuit design. In the long term, I hope to contribute to the development of processors and other digital hardware.
ambitionNote: I am especially interested in the work of companies such as STMicroelectronics, NVIDIA, Intel, AMD and Arm.
timelineCurrentBody: Engineering studies in Sciences Numériques (SN), with a growing focus on digital systems and hardware.
timelinePreviousBody: Preparatory classes in MP2I and MPI, building a foundation in mathematics, computing and engineering sciences.
fieldNoteBody: Growing and selling tomatoes during summer breaks meant caring for as many as 400 plants. It called for steady hands-on work and attention to planning, upkeep and logistics.
hobbiesBody: In my free time, I enjoy tinkering with computers, programming and riding motorcycles. At home, I share life with three cats: Dino, Alphonse and Clandestina.
motorcycleAlt: Placeholder image for Jonas's Suzuki SV650 motorcycle
catsAlt: Placeholder image for Jonas's three cats
projectAsteroidosBody: An Asteroids-inspired game built around evasive play. The camera follows the player through an expanding playfield, where asteroids must be avoided rather than destroyed.
projectVoxelBody: A high-speed voxel generation system developed in Rust with the Bevy game engine for an unfinished game project.
projectCoreWarBody: A genomic evolver for the programming game Core War, developed as part of my TIPE project.
projectCpuBody: A CPU designed in Logisim, exploring processor architecture and digital logic through hands-on experimentation.
footerNote: For professional opportunities and conversations about digital hardware.
